prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 86.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 84.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 71.1%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 89.8%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 73.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 34.5%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Buddy Sandbox Playground Screen: Adds a dedicated interactive sandbox screen before finishing onboarding where users directly test pet hotkeys, movement behavior, and desktop hiding controls. (why: 3 support tickets reported post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or interact with the pet, and finish step drop-off is 26.2%.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Taskbar & Multi-Display Launch Guide Screen: Inserts a screen demonstrating system tray docking and multi-monitor setup options so users know where to find the pet if invisible. (why: 3 support emails reported that pets do not show on desktop or the app will not open after completing setup.)
2: [adoption, hint] Photo Fail-Safe Auto-Enhancer Guidance: Adds explicit real-time photographic lighting and contrast hints to prevent custom pet generation failures. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failing or producing bad visual results during the custom adoption branch.)
3: [sign_in, wait_info] Cloud Pet Save Security Confirmation Hint: Displays microcopy reassuring users that their custom pets and items will be backed up safely under their signed-in account. (why: 8 support emails cited lost pet profiles or missing companions after account re-authentication.)
4: [choose_path, hint] Guided Path Speed Quiz Card Hint: Adds a path recommendation hint comparing instant companion adoption time versus full custom pet creation. (why: Choose path screen has a large mean duration of 514s and 13.8% drop-off.)
